sections.title: About per-sulii
sections.body: Modern aesthetic medicine has come a long way and can transform skin quickly, but when treatments aren't done by a physician, the results aren't always perfect — skin that's been over-treated, again and again, can start to look unnatural. From that point of view, plenty of people who skip clinical treatments still want to look naturally beautiful. That's why per-sulii developed V-essence and S-essence, a duo formulated to nurture great skin at home. V-essence and S-essence are led by experts with international R&D backgrounds, who carefully selected peptides and refined the formula through serious research. It conditions skin and reduces photosensitivity damage, without retinoic acid, retinal, or retinol. Use V first, then S every day, and let your skin quietly become more beautiful, naturally.

sections.title: The per-sulii Duo
sections.body: per-sulii V-essence (Bee Peptide PLUS) fades fine lines, refines pores, and firms skin — safe and natural. per-sulii S-essence (Premium Exosomes + Multi-Peptides) softens, brightens, and refines skin texture — safe and natural.

sections.title: per-sulii, in Pursuit of Bare-Faced Beauty
sections.body: Bare-faced beauty is beauty with real charm. The per-sulii duo doesn't change your skin's structure — it conditions your skin. Suitable for men, women, and teens (recommended for ages 12+), it helps you nurture bare-faced beauty at home, with ease.

sections.title: TAIWAN Science
sections.body: The per-sulii team is led by research experts who previously held senior R&D roles at international pharmaceutical companies, committed to rigorous, safe formulas produced under Taiwan's quality GMP process — made for those pursuing natural, bare-faced beauty.per-suliiMade in Taiwan
